svg.title: Undergraduate at Sun Yat-sen University & Research Intern at SimpleAI My research focuses on world models, video generation, and embodied intelligence. At SimpleAI’s Simple World Lab, I work on embodied foundation models and frontier research in Physical Intelligence, exploring how generative models connect perception, reasoning, and action. I also develop AI-assisted research tools with InkMind.AI. I am currently applying for PhD positions in Hong Kong.
